If you slay a {u}{b}{c_important}Portal Prankster{/c}{/b}{/u} within the {c_important}Undercity{/c}, the {c_important}Cabochon Merchant{/c} will appear after killing the {c_important}District Boss{/c}.

The {c_important}Cabochon Merchant{/c} will sell you {c_rune}Runes{/c} and {c_important}Gems{/c} for {c_important}Gold{/c}.
